name: Yamaha SR400
engine: 399 cc air-cooled SOHC single, fuel injected, kick start only
intro: A simple kick-start single. 2015-2018 bikes had a recall for an oil hose that can leak onto the rear tire.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2015-2018 SR400s are in recall 18V730 because the oil hose flare nut may be loose and leak oil onto the rear tire.
A-002.reason: Oil on the rear tire can cause a crash. The fix is free.

recalls.what: Engine oil line flare nut may be loose and leak oil onto the rear tire.
recalls.fix: Dealer tightens the nut, or replaces the oil line if it leaks, free.
